Class EstacionMeteorologica

java.lang.Object
meteorologia.EstacionMeteorologica
All Implemented Interfaces:
IDocumento
public class EstacionMeteorologica extends Object implements IDocumento

      public void asociarConversor(String sensorId, IConversor nuevoConversor) throws SensorNoEncontradoException, ConversionNoCompatibleException
